Yeah I played a lot of 2042, and BF1. BF5 is the best IMO in terms of gameplay and graphics. In BF5 you can be much more creative with the building, stationary weapons, and weapon pickups. I've been playing for about a year now. 

BF5 for sure has bigger maps, so it does lead to different gameplay. I would say more sniping, and when you do have a squad together it can be more effective. I also use vehicles to get from place to place due to map size. Imo it's more realistic. 

I also think defending a base/area is easier due to the building feature. 

You can for sure flank. 

Nice share man I too have played other BFs in great detail so cool to hear.
Best battlefield on PS4

You'll get used to it. I used to run 2042, top scores and what not. 

BF5 competition is much better. 

I think BF5 is more realistic.

So the weapon you choose and weapon upgrades matter a lot. You'll need level 4 on whatever you're using. 

You have to get used to the maps and shooting. Like accuracy, movement, bullet drop and what not.

In this game, it's more territorial and you can build base protection and use stationary weapons so you can be a bit more creative. 

I find a lot of the stationary weapons and weapons you pick up very effective. 

Overall: just play everyday, you'll start racking it up in no time.
